# An effect in a component built at run time, keyed on a package var written
# outside it, runs when the var is written: its `@update`, the remount of a
# keyed `@mount`, and a query asking again, for the one instance under an `if`
# and for every copy under a `for`. The write in the page named the
# instance's flag and settle bare, so fyne, gtk4 and android did not build,
# and html built and ran none of it. passEffectOutsideKeys hands the instance
# the var as a prop. testdata/effect_keyed_on_package_var_runtime_instance.txtar
# is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

var level = 0
var asked list[int] = []
var mounts list[int] = []

func lookup(n int) async.Result[string] {
    asked.push(n)
    return {ok="level {n}"}
}

component gauge ui.node {
    var seen = 0
    var answer option[string] = null

    effect(on=level, @update(n) {
        seen = n
    })
    effect(on=level, @mount(n) {
        mounts.push(n)
    })
    async.query(on=level, fetch=lookup, :value=answer)
    ui.text #shown(value=answer != null ? answer : "-")
}

component app ui.node {
    var open = true
    var copies = [1, 2]

    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #raise(text="raise", @click {
            level += 1
        })
        if open {
            gauge #g
        }
        for var k = copies {
            gauge #row
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    app()
}

func testAWriteOutsideReachesTheEffect(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.raise.click()
    t.assert(c.g != null && c.g.seen == 1)
    t.assert(c.row[0].seen == 1 && c.row[1].seen == 1)
}

func testAWriteOutsideRemountsAKeyedEffect(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.raise.click()
    t.assert(mounts.join(",") == "0,0,0,1,1,1")
}

func testAWriteOutsideAsksTheQueryAgain(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.raise.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.g != null && c.g.answer != null && c.g.answer == "level 1", 2000)
    t.assert(asked.join(",") == "0,0,0,1,1,1")
}
